dev-s122b-classifier_off-violation.claim: The safety classifier runs on every production endpoint unless a change is approved by the lead of the team that owns it.

cast: Project Heron (svc-194) is a production endpoint, owned by team delta
Priya Raman (staff id u44186) leads team delta
Project Juniper (svc-727) is a production endpoint, serving Pellucid Biotech, owned by team delta
Elena Vasquez (staff id u37992) leads team atlas

timeline.text: Change request CR-5587 to disable the classifier on Project Juniper is approved by Priya Raman
Change request CR-1733 to disable the classifier for deploy 9164 on Project Heron is approved by Elena Vasquez
Deploy 9164 turns the safety classifier off on Project Heron (production)
Monitoring shows Project Heron serving with no safety classifier

story.verdict: Violation: deploy 9164 turned the classifier off on Project Heron, a production endpoint, with no prior approval from the lead of team delta (CR-5587 approves a change to Project Juniper, not Project Heron; CR-1733 was approved by Elena Vasquez, who doesn't lead team delta).
story.reason: The classifier was switched off without the owning team's lead approving it: CR-5587 is for another endpoint; CR-1733 was approved by the lead of another team.

chain.says: Deploy 9164's endpoint is the one in the ownership record
The owning team is the team in the org chart
CR-1733's approver is not the owning team's lead
CR-5587 is for a different endpoint
